WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    o.lunarstage,
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as station_avg_bandwidth
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
),
all_stations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    o.lunarstage,
    o.observstation
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    all_stations.lunarstage as phase,
    AVG(station_averages.station_avg_bandwidth) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(DISTINCT all_stations.observstation) as station_count
  FROM all_stations
  LEFT JOIN station_averages 
    ON all_stations.observstation = station_averages.observstation 
    AND all_stations.lunarstage = station_averages.lunarstage
  GROUP BY all_stations.lunarstage
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) as total
  FROM all_stations
)
SELECT
  phase_stats.phase,
  phase_stats.avg_bandwidth,
  phase_stats.station_count,
  CAST(phase_stats.station_count AS FLOAT) / total_count.total as fraction
FROM phase_stats
CROSS JOIN total_count
ORDER BY phase_stats.phase
